task_definition.environment: reach_hold.json original gravity, mount, non-contact floor and no external forces
task_definition.payload: Original family_space_v2/v1 rigid 0.01 kg payload, declared COM and full inertia, no payload modification

structure_domain.family: family_space_v2.json scoped to two segments and six tendons
structure_domain.fixed: Original prototype materials, sections, distributed_consecutive six-tendon routing, all 12 cells/segment, backend.family_mujoco@1.2.0, model.serial_bending_cells@1.0.0, ideal unilateral 0..8 N tensions

prescreen.coverage: Search proposes/ranks on positive_high ONLY. Then each proposed structure is actually solved for all three tasks; no single-task score is presented as a shared score.
prescreen.aggregate: V_BF7 = max of three finite trajectory.replayed_violation values; all task-specific CONIC solves, valid affine replay and full norm/sample coverage required. Otherwise unresolved.
prescreen.selection: Best complete shared score, tie by proposal index. Peer is proposal zero if distinct; otherwise next ranked distinct proposal. No manual score override.

physical.continuation: Freeze one new phase config after first real evidence, retain same Study ledger and original total ceiling. Only failed tasks with reliable full feedback and >=5% max normalized violation reduction from seed and continuing response improvement qualify. Passing tasks are not reoptimized. No condition/task/structure changes.
physical.acceptance: Original registered evaluate.reach and offline Reach/Hold acceptance on complete 600-step runs, terminal 10mm, four inclusive holding samples with 10mm/30mm_s bounds, force bounds and solver validity; joint SELECT only with three passing owned independent replays on identical structure/discretization.
physical.stop: Each Study SELECT at first joint independent pass, otherwise STOP after initial non-improvement or one finite continuation. Separate peer comparison remains authorized. No formal three-strategy benchmark.

accounting: All construction, invalid/failed models, internal solves, Native attempts, full replay and driver costs preserved. Store numeric and driver overlap and are separate. Historical B Stores/successful inputs are never read or imported.
